preconditions.description: The number of operations is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(ai, str) and 1 <= len(ai) <= 15 and ai.islower() for ai in assignments)
preconditions.description: Each assignment name is a string of lowercase letters with length between 1 and 15.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= 10**9 for xi in priorities)
preconditions.description: Each priority value is an integer between 1 and 1,000,000,000.
The number of days to undo is less than the current day index.

postconditions.description: For a query operation, return the number of assignments with a priority lower than the given assignment, or -1 if the assignment is not in the list.

invariants.description: The number of assignments matches the number of priorities.

invariants.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) for x in priorities)
